subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Summer Picnic
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce that our annual summer picnic will be held on Saturday, July 24th at the local park. Join us for a day of fun activities, delicious food, and great company. Please RSVP by July 10th so we can make the necessary arrangements. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
